adjudication.rationale: The diff does show TopicEmbed.import now derives the post category only from an EmbeddableHost lookup (`eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` then `category: eh.try(:category_id)`) and the global `embed_category` setting is removed (site_settings.yml/server locale; plus migration deletes it). There is no fallback category in TopicEmbed.import if no host record is found. However, whether “feed-polling imports” (or any other caller) can reach TopicEmbed.import without a prior host-allowed check is not shown in this diff, and the exact behavior when PostCreator receives `category: nil` (e.g., defaulting to Uncategorized) is also not demonstrated here. So the finding is a valid, diff-grounded edge-case/behavior-change concern but not a verifiable defect from the provided changes alone.
